title: Package bytes for transport
responsibility: Encodes bytes for transport with their length, media type and SHA-256 hash.

inputs.name: binaryAnswer.bytes
inputs.description: The bytes to encode. Their length and hash are calculated directly from this array.

inputs.name: binaryAnswer.mediaType
inputs.description: The media type to label the answer with; defaults to image/png. The function does not inspect the bytes to verify this label.

outputs.name: binaryAnswer
outputs.description: An object containing base64 data, encoding set to base64, the supplied media type, byte length and calculated SHA-256 hash.
